quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a seamless vibration with no surface clue, distinguishable from engines by its smoothness.
quests.explanation: The unique smoothness of maglev cargo vibration under a street distinguishes a cyber city.
quests.textToSpeak: Ground-level maglev cargo moves so smoothly beneath the streets that only vibration betrays it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for harmonically layered wind tones created by passing through different tree densities.
quests.explanation: Harmonically layered wind tones in a tree-dense environment identify a mountain forest.
quests.textToSpeak: Wind moves through a mountain forest with a harmonic layering created by tree density.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for life-support hum that seems lighter and less grounded than on a surface.
quests.explanation: Lighter-seeming life-support hum in free fall identifies a spacecraft in outer space.
quests.textToSpeak: The spacecraft drifts in free fall; even the life-support hum seems to carry less weight.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the most precise and quietest possible machine hum of a molecular-scale device.
quests.explanation: Molecular-scale printing identifies the most advanced tier of a scientific laboratory.
quests.textToSpeak: A 3D molecular printer whirs continuously as it assembles a structure atom by atom.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the faint distant sound of military formation commands heard from outside a facility.
quests.explanation: Faint pre-dawn military commands heard from outside a perimeter identify a military base.
quests.textToSpeak: Pre-dawn formation calls are barely audible from outside the base perimeter.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the hiss of extreme heat from a seafloor vent in a completely dark, pressurized environment.
quests.explanation: Extreme volcanic vent heat in complete deep-water darkness identifies the deep ocean floor.
quests.textToSpeak: Volcanic vent tube worms sway in heat that would be fatal to most life forms.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for an intermittent brief shudder in an underground space, caused by above-ground transit.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the station's hum as the day-night line creeps across the visible globe in silence.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a silence that has texture and depth from centuries of accumulated resonance.
quests.explanation: Textured, deep sacred silence identifies an ancient temple site.

quests.hint: Listen for refrigeration hum beneath PA audio as layers of sound in a transit departure area.

quests.hint: Listen for the unique echo quality of a vaulted stone space that carries the acoustic ghost of steam.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the quality of silence that has been shaped by decades of careful scholarly use.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
